root_cause_evidence.exact_runtime_error: CommandNotFoundException / FullyQualifiedErrorId=CommandNotFoundException; "if : The term 'if' is not recognized as the name of a cmdlet, function, script file, or operable program."
root_cause_evidence.runtime_report_location: line 56 char 45, at the first inline if within staging re-decode.
root_cause_evidence.offending_assumption: PowerShell if can be used as a value expression directly inside parenthesized .NET method arguments.
root_cause_evidence.ast_classification: Both occurrences of if($hasBom){3}else{0} are CommandAst with command_name "if", so invocation attempted to resolve a command named if and failed before UTF8Encoding.GetString could run.

why_structural_validation_and_replace_di: The staging file had already been written and reloaded, and the length check passed.

The failing re-decode assignment occurs before checks for exactly one new command, command-only byte equality, env section/key count 21, FRESH mode, PG mapping, zero args/implicit stdio, and staging hash.
ErrorActionPreference=Stop converted the runtime CommandNotFoundException into immediate termination.
[IO.File]::Replace is later in the inline script (extracted line 70), so control never reached it. Atomic backup was NOT_CREATED and switch remained NOT_RUN.
minimal_remediation: Do not reuse or inspect the failed staging or backup.
In a separately authorized remediation worker, create a fresh run-specific staging after all current preflights.
Replace exactly the failing re-decode line with: $stageDecoded=$utf8.GetString($stageReload,$offset,$stageReload.Length-$offset)

Leave expected-before SHA verification, command-only replacement and reverse-comparison, BOM reconstruction, 21 env/credentials, FRESH, PG mapping, quote semantics, zero args/implicit stdio, structural checks, staging hash, and the placement of File.Replace after every validation unchanged.
Static parse of this one-line correction: parser_error_count=0, if CommandAst count=0; execution NOT_RUN_BY_DIAGNOSIS_SCOPE.
